title: RepViT
description: RepViT (Wang et al. 2024): a mobile CNN classifier laid out like a ViT, re-parameterised to plain convolutions.
html:

Details
  • Paper: RepViT: Revisiting Mobile CNN From ViT Perspective, CVPR 2024, 2023-07-18
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/THU-MIG/RepViT (PyTorch): timm carries the architecture and the converted authors' checkpoints in its own, simpler API.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/timm/repvit_m1_1.dist_450e_in1k/blob/ff441038a42982fff1c8c75be7c794f9ba76db72/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (ImageNet-1k with distillation from a RegNetY-16GF teacher (RepViT paper), 300 or 450 epochs)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: repvit_m0_9.dist_300e_in1k (default of repvit_m0_9), repvit_m0_9.dist_450e_in1k, repvit_m1_0.dist_300e_in1k (default of repvit_m1_0), repvit_m1_0.dist_450e_in1k, repvit_m1_1.dist_300e_in1k (default of repvit_m1_1), repvit_m1_1.dist_450e_in1k, repvit_m1_5.dist_300e_in1k (default of repvit_m1_5), repvit_m1_5.dist_450e_in1k, repvit_m2_3.dist_300e_in1k (default of repvit_m2_3), repvit_m2_3.dist_450e_in1k
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: imagenet-1k
  • Input size: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 235) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): repvit_m0_9.dist_300e_in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.0 reserved); repvit_m0_9.dist_450e_in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.0 reserved); repvit_m1_0.dist_300e_in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.0 reserved); repvit_m1_0.dist_450e_in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.0 reserved); repvit_m1_1.dist_300e_in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); repvit_m1_1.dist_450e_in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); repvit_m1_5.dist_300e_in1k 224x224 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); repvit_m1_5.dist_450e_in1k 224x224 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); repvit_m2_3.dist_300e_in1k 224x224 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); repvit_m2_3.dist_450e_in1k 224x224 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved)
